description: Change the stacking order (Stapelreihenfolge) of an object within its layer: bring_to_front, send_to_back, bring_forward or send_backward. Newly created objects always start on top. Returns frame_id and action.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: set_frame_stacking
title: Change stacking order
